reason: A DeepSeek Harness monitoring plugin that analyzes live reasoning-stream wording indicators, presents trajectory classifications in the UI, and optionally records aggregate session measurements.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的实时推理轨迹监控插件，可统计措辞指标、展示会话画像判断，并按需记录聚合测量数据。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors live reasoning-trajectory wording indicators, displays session profile judgments, and optionally records aggregate measurements.

capabilities: Observes live reasoning-stream events within DeepSeek Harness sessions
Computes wording indicators and trajectory-profile classifications
Displays session badges and a real-time panel
Optionally writes aggregate per-session records to JSONL or event output
Registers a local records route and includes an optional installation patch for web settings exposure
